post.title: Your Best Holiday Wasn't That Great (While You Were There) #shorts
post.description: Which trip got better in your memory? Tell me in the comments. Send this to the friend who calls every holiday 'perfect'. Mae's holiday photos look perfect, but it rained for three days. In 'Temporal Adjustments in the Evaluation of Events: The Rosy View' (Journal of Experimental Social Psychology, 1997), Terence Mitchell, Leigh Thompson, Erika Peterson and Randy Cronk asked people about a European tour, a Thanksgiving trip home and a three-week California bike tour before, during and after. On the bike tour, only 5% expected to be disappointed, 61% said they felt disappointed during the trip, and a week later only 11% remembered being disappointed. Looking forward and looking back felt better than being there. It's called rosy retrospection, and it isn't lying: your memory keeps the good parts. #psychology #shorts #rosyretrospection #memory #overthinking
